request: A finding's location is written as a path and a line. Files that carry no extension, such as a Makefile or a dotfile like .gitignore, must locate like any other file, while a host and port pair or a clock time must never be read as a location.

defects.description: Own-history fix 5135da13a3 (2026-09-25): fix(plan): accept dotfiles and extensionless build files as path:line

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/plan/cite_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestPathCiteAcceptsExtensionlessFilesAndRejectsNonPaths)$' ./internal/plan >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
